body:
## Story Points: 3 | Priority: P1 | Sprint: 2

## Summary
Track payment status per parking session and produce a receipt on successful payment.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Payment entity: amount, currency (INR), method (CASH/CARD/DIGITAL_WALLET), status, transactionRef, paidAt
- [ ] One payment per parking record enforced by DB unique constraint
- [ ] Mock: always SUCCESS; no card numbers, CVV, or PINs stored ever
- [ ] Re-exit on completed ticket prevented (403)
- [ ] Receipt returned in exit response: receiptId, all session details
- [ ] UI clearly states payment is simulated for academic project

## Definition of Done
Payment record saved on exit; duplicate payment blocked; receipt displayed in UI with simulation note.
